integrity: The proof reconstructs the published alternating-matching vertices and H-description, derives an exact common vertex sphere, proves a general projection theorem for common-sphere point sets, and translates the shard H-description into an exact balanced-prefix membership criterion. The uniform-density equivalence is attributed to the supporting matroid theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard shard-polytope realization. It gives the true minimum enclosing radius in all cases through an exact projection-distance formula, but gives a closed word formula only for deciding when the canonical all-vertex sphere is already minimal. The uniform-density interpretation is applied after deleting the source loops outside the active interval.
title: Shard polytopes have a canonical vertex sphere with a balanced-prefix minimum-sphere criterion
